'''Sanjeev Anant Galande''' (born 20 September 1967) is an Indian cell biologist, [[epigeneticist]], academic, former chair of biology and the dean of research and development at the [[Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Pune]].<ref name="About Sanjeev Galande">{{cite web | url=http://www.iiti.ac.in/Seminars/Abstract/PSG.pdf | title=About Sanjeev Galande | publisher=Indian Institute of Technology Indore | date=2016 | access-date=31 October 2016}}</ref> He heads the Laboratory of Chromatin Biology and Epigenetics (Sanjeev Galande Lab) at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Pune. He is the founder of the ''Centre of Excellence in Epigenetics'' at IISER Pune and is known for his studies on higher-order [[chromatin]] architecture and how it influences spatiotemporal changes in [[gene expression]].<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee">{{cite web | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/content/Detail.aspx?AID=128 | title=Brief Profile of the Awardee | publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize | date=2016 | access-date=5 October 2016}}</ref> He is an elected fellow of the [[Indian National Science Academy]]<ref name="Indian fellow - Galande">{{cite web | url=http://insaindia.res.in/detail.php?id=P12-1573 | title=Indian fellow - Galande | publisher=Indian National Science Academy | date=2016 | access-date=26 October 2016}}</ref> and the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]]<ref name="Fellow Profile - Galande">{{cite web | url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Galande,_Dr_Sanjeev | title=Fellow Profile - Galande | publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences | date=2016 | access-date=25 October 2016}}</ref> and a recipient of the [[National Bioscience Award for Career Development]] of the [[Department of Biotechnology]].<ref name="Awardees of National Bioscience Awards for Career Development">{{cite web | url=http://dbtindia.nic.in/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/list_of_bioscience_awardees.pdf | title=Awardees of National Bioscience Awards for Career Development | publisher=Department of Biotechnology | date=2016 | access-date=17 October 2016 | archive-date=4 March 2018 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180304191331/http://dbtindia.nic.in/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/list_of_bioscience_awardees.pdf | url-status=dead }}</ref> The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]], the apex agency of the Government of India for scientific research, awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards, in 2010, for his contributions to biological sciences.<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees">{{cite web | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/AwardeeList.aspx | title=View Bhatnagar Awardees | publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize | date=2016 | access-date=5 October 2016}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Sanjeev Galande, born on 20 September 1967 in [[Pune]], in the western Indian state of [[Maharashtra]], did his master's degree in biochemistry (MSc) at the [[Savitribai Phule Pune University]]<ref name="Message from Dr. Sanjeev Galande, highly decorated scientist and ex-alumnus of M.Sc. Biotechnology from University of Pune">{{cite web | url=https://sumangovil.wordpress.com/2015/08/12/message-from-dr-sanjeev-galande-highly-decorated-scientist-and-ex-alumnus-of-m-sc-biotechnology-from-university-of-pune/ | title=Message from Dr. Sanjeev Galande, highly decorated scientist and ex-alumnus of M.Sc. Biotechnology from University of Pune | publisher=Opportunities and Concerns in Biotechnology | date=12 August 2015 | access-date=31 October 2016}}</ref> before obtaining his doctoral studies from the [[Indian Institute of Science]] in 1996.<ref name="Scientist Sanjeev Galande selected for GD Birla Award">{{cite web | url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/pune/Scientist-Sanjeev-Galande-selected-for-GD-Birla-Award/articleshow/47949930.cms?gclid=CMO8rp2DgtACFUoWaAodp8kIrQ | title=Scientist Sanjeev Galande selected for GD Birla Award | work=The Hindu | date=15 July 2015 | access-date=31 October 2016}}</ref> He moved to the US the same year to join the [[Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory]] to complete his postdoctoral studies on the ''role of MAR-binding proteins in [[tumorigenesis]]'' in 2001 and on his return to India, he joined [[National Centre for Cell Science]] (NCCS) as a senior scientist.<ref name="SG Lab Members">{{cite web | url=http://sanjeevgalande.wixsite.com/sglab-coee/members | title=SG Lab Members | publisher=SG Lab | date=2016 | access-date=1 November 2016}}</ref> He headed the Sanjeev Galande Laboratory at the NCCS till 2010 when he shifted to the [[Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Pune]] as a professor<ref name="Faculty Details ">{{cite web | url=http://www.iiserpune.ac.in/people/faculty-details/21 | title=Faculty Details | publisher=Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Pune | date=2016 | access-date=1 November 2016}}</ref> and established the ''Centre of Excellence in Epigenetics'' (CoEE) there.<ref name="Sanjeev Galande on CoEE">{{cite web | url=http://www.iiserpune.ac.in/~coee/wiki/index.php/Sanjeev_Galande | title=Sanjeev Galande on CoEE | publisher=CoEE - IISER Pune | date=2016 | access-date=1 November 2016}}</ref> He heads the ''Laboratory of Chromatin Biology and Epigenetics'' where he hosts a number of researchers who focus their studies on ''evolution of epigenetic mechanisms using multiple model systems''.<ref name="Laboratory of Chromatin Biology and Epigenetics">{{cite web | url=http://sanjeevgalande.wixsite.com/sglab-coee | title=Laboratory of Chromatin Biology and Epigenetics | publisher=Laboratory of Chromatin Biology and Epigenetics | date=2016 | access-date=1 November 2016}}</ref> He also serves as an adjunct faculty at [[Savitribai Phule Pune University]].<ref name="Adjunct Faculty ">{{cite web | url=http://www.unipune.ac.in/dept/science/Biotechnology/Biotechnology_webfiles/faculty.htm | title=Adjunct Faculty | publisher=Savitribai Phule Pune University | date=2016 | access-date=1 November 2016}}</ref>

== Legacy ==
Galande's early researches during his doctoral studies were on MAR-binding proteins and [[carcinogenesis]] but later he shifted his focus to cell-type specific patterns of [[gene expression]] and how [[chromatin]] levels influence them which was the theme of his research at NCCS.<ref name="SG Lab Members" /> His team demonstrated how cellular signaling pathways impact the chromatin levels. After his move to IISER, Pune, he started working on [[epigenetic regulation]] on various substrata viz. [[yeast]], [[Caenorhabditis elegans]] (round worm), [[Drosophila]] (fruit flies), [[Zebrafish]] and humans, using them as biological model systems.<ref name="Sanjeev Galande on CoEE" /> His team investigate biological processes such as [[Transcription (biology)|transcription]], [[gene regulation]], [[cell proliferation]], self-renewal and regeneration and their interrelations for which they employ genetic, biochemical, molecular and computational approaches. His studies are reported to have assisted in widening our understanding of the development and differentiation of [[T cell]]s and the impact of [[Wnt signaling pathway]]s in the process.<ref name="Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners">{{cite web | url=http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf | title=Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners | publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research | date=1999 | access-date=5 October 2016 | pages=34}}</ref> He is involved in three running projects; ''Intergenerational programming of diabesity in offspring of women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (InDiaGDM)'', ''Role of chromatin organizer [[SATB1]] in T cell development and differentiation'' and ''The role of Chromatin reorganisers in X inactivation''.<ref name="Projects">{{cite web | url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Sanjeev_Galande | title=Projects | date=2016 | access-date=1 November 2016}}</ref>

Galande has detailed his research in a number of articles{{Refn|group=note|Please see ''Selected bibliography'' section}} and [[ResearchGate]], an online article repository has listed 87 of them.<ref name="Sanjeev Galande on ResearchGate">{{cite web | url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Sanjeev_Galande/publications | title=Sanjeev Galande on ResearchGate | date=2016 | access-date=1 November 2016}}</ref> He has mentored several scholars at his laboratories in NCCS and IISER and coordinated the ''National Research Scholars Meet in Life Sciences'' in 2005.<ref name="National Research Scholars Meet in Life Sciences">{{cite web | url=http://graduatestudentsmeet.weebly.com/-hall-of-fame.html | title=National Research Scholars Meet in Life Sciences | publisher=Graduate Students Meet | date=2016 | access-date=1 November 2016}}</ref> He has also established a number of multidisciplinary academic programs at IISER which covers such topics as biochemistry, [[molecular biology]], [[bioinformatics]], cell biology, [[proteomics]], and [[genomics]] and has participated in several seminars on these topics.<ref name="About Sanjeev Galande" />

== Awards and honors ==
Galande's contributions to the biological sciences earned him the [[National Bioscience Award for Career Development]] of the [[Department of Biotechnology]] (DBT) in 2006.<ref name="Awardees of National Bioscience Awards for Career Development" /> The same year, DBT selected him for the ''Swarnajayanthi Fellowship'' for life sciences.<ref name="Swarnajayanthi Fellowship">{{cite web | url=http://dst.gov.in/sites/default/files/sjaward06-07.pdf | title=Swarnajayanthi Fellowship | publisher=Department of Biotechnology | date=2006 | access-date=1 November 2016}}</ref> In 2010, he was awarded the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards, by the [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]]<ref name="Scientist Sanjeev Galande gets G D Birla award">{{cite web | url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/scientist-sanjeev-galande-gets-g-d-birla-award-115070100612_1.html | title=Scientist Sanjeev Galande gets G D Birla award | publisher=Business Standard | date=1 July 2015 | access-date=1 November 2016}}</ref> and the [[Wellcome Trust]] chose him for the Senior Research Fellowships in Basic Biomedical Science.<ref name="About Sanjeev Galande" /> He received the 2014 [[G. D. Birla Award for Scientific Research]] of the [[K. K. Birla Foundation]] in 2015.<ref name="Scientist Sanjeev Galande selected for GD Birla Award 2">{{cite web | url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/pune/Scientist-Sanjeev-Galande-selected-for-GD-Birla-Award/articleshow/47949930.cms | title=Scientist Sanjeev Galande selected for GD Birla Award | publisher=Times of India | date=5 July 2015 | access-date=1 November 2016}}</ref> He is an elected fellow of two major Indian science academies, [[Indian Academy of Sciences]] (2010)<ref name="Fellow Profile - Galande" /> and [[Indian National Science Academy]] (2012).<ref name="Indian fellow - Galande" />
